title: Tilted Character Travel Editorial
summary: Turn a character into a Japanese travel-magazine poster: an extreme close-up and sharply tilted head interrupt a precise editorial grid, oversized Chinese type, and deadpan travel information.
seoDescription: Create a Japanese travel-editorial poster with a sideways character close-up, multilingual typography, and restrained colors. Customize the pose, expression, and setting.
inputRequirement: Enter a character name in [Character]. The source describes direct text-to-image generation; a reference image is not required.
howToUse: Choose the entry side, expression, and background, then copy the complete prompt.
Replace [Character] with your character name while keeping the identifying features and the rest of the instructions.
Paste the prompt into your image generator. The author reports using GPT Image 2; keep the 70–90° head tilt, direct eye contact, and formal travel-editorial layout.
Review the multilingual lettering, recognizable features, and information hierarchy in the result. Adjust the character name or travel copy in the copied text if needed.
exampleNotice: Four examples from the author’s original X post are shown as complete posters, resized without cropping. They illustrate the source’s style; the exact prompts, selections, and generation settings for each image are not provided.
verificationNotice: The author reports generating these examples with GPT Image 2. This project has not independently generated or model-verified them.
adaptationNotice: The Chinese default preserves the full source prompt, and English is a complete translation. The selectors narrow alternatives explicitly named in the source. The character placeholder remains editable in the copied text.
